text: You are going to investigate the reaction between dilute hydrochloric acid and three different
concentrations of aqueous sodium hydroxide, labelled R, S and T.
Read all the instructions carefully before starting the experiments.
Instructions

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Do a flame test on a small sample of solid U.
Record your observations.

Add the rest of solid U to about 10cm of distilled water in a boiling tube. Stopper the boiling tube
and shake the mixture to dissolve solid U and form solution U.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Describe the colour of solution U.

Divide solution U into three approximately equal portions in three test-tubes.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
Add a few drops of aqueous sodium hydroxide to the first portion of solution U.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Now add an excess of aqueous sodium hydroxide to this mixture.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
Add a few drops of aqueous ammonia to the second portion of solution U.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Now add an excess of aqueous ammonia to this mixture.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
Add a few drops of dilute nitric acid and about 1cm of aqueous barium nitrate to the third
portion of solution U. Leave to stand for 5 minutes.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (f)
parts.text:
Solid U contains three different ions.
What conclusions can you draw about the ions present in solid U?

tests on liquid V

parts.label: (g)
parts.text:
Describe the appearance of liquid V.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (h)
parts.text:
Use a teat pipette to place a few drops of liquid V onto a watch-glass. Put the stopper back into
the test-tube of liquid V. Use a lighted splint to touch the surface of liquid V carefully.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
Use a spatula to transfer a small crystal of iodine carefully into the rest of liquid V in the
stoppered test-tube. Put the stopper back into the test-tube and shake the test-tube.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (j)
parts.text: Draw one conclusion about liquid V.

dissolve in water is endothermic.

change per gram.
